name: ed-tools-passwords-tests
description: Dev-only tests for the ED tools passwords page. GitHub Pages publishes this folder too (the repo is public); nothing in it is secret.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:flows
scripts.test:flows: node make-site.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-mgh-ed-admin "node --test --test-concurrency=1 flows/*.test.mjs"
